records.text: Korea ends the fourteen-year restriction on domestic financial firms buying kimchi bonds — explicitly to relieve dollar-drain pressure after some $42 billion flowed into overseas stocks and stablecoins in one quarter. The token outflow is now bending Korea's FX plumbing.
